title: SharedWorker WebSocket Shields Bypass
description: Tests whether a WebSocket opened inside a SharedWorker bypasses Brave Shields network filtering. Brave only installs its WebSocket proxy when Chromium supplies a non-null RenderFrameHost, so a frameless SharedWorker socket skips BraveProxyingWebSocket and the adblock engines. The same endpoint is opened from the page, a dedicated worker, and a shared worker; with a matching custom filter, the page and dedicated worker are blocked while the shared worker connects.
